description.narrative: Contribute to the stabilisation and recovery of the Ukrainian economy through private sector investments that support sustainable growth, job creation, the green transition, and business resilience.

Impact Fund Denmark (IFDK) is Denmark’s development finance institution, supporting sustainable private sector investments in developing countries. IFDK invests in sustainable growth and high-impact solutions, mobilising capital to tackle global challenges where the need is greatest. The focus is on investments that offer high development impact and scalable business opportunities.
The IFDK Ukraine Facility provides loans, equity and fund investments to Ukrainian private sector companies to support economic recovery and reconstruction. The facility mobilises additional private capital for investments in strategic sectors such as renewable energy, agriculture, healthcare, infrastructure and financial services, while promoting job creation, responsible business practices, gender inclusion, and compliance with international ESG standards.
Development effects of investments projects often take years to materialize, making them difficult to capture within short reporting periods. As a result, the indicator reporting focuses on tangible outputs, such as the number of investments, as proxies, based on the assumption that these will contribute to long-term development impact. To learn more about the development effects, see the case stories on IFDK’s website, in IFDK’s Annual Report.
